title: VSift search data, brief view v1
description: The data member of a complete or partial search result asked for with --view brief (0.2.1): search-data.schema.json with each item reduced to transcript-segment-brief.schema.json and a view member that is always brief. The parallel hits (segment_id and how it matched), the normalised query, the requested range, the cursor and transcript_coverage are the full page's own, and the revision block holds once what the full view repeats on every item. Validate the envelope with operation-response.schema.json: its coverage member is truncated, and its status partial, exactly when transcript_coverage.untranscribed_ranges is not empty. The view is refused with --events jsonl. Pass next_cursor back with the same session, query, range, revision and view to continue.
